parts.text: I don't know how jobs arrive or what specific details they have, but deliveries carry a load from one site to another, and inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where they started. Drones fly along corridors between named sites, which have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time. I need help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off the flight before it leaves.
